name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Brush | Bubblegum
description: Get ready for a sweet and smooth experience with Fresh Canna’s 2G Live Resin Concentrate Brush – Bubblegum, a deliciously nostalgic hybrid known for its candy-like flavor and balanced high. This easy-to-use applicator delivers precision dosing of our terpene-rich live resin, perfect for dabs, joints, blunts, or enhancing your bowl. With sweet berry, floral, and classic bubblegum notes, this strain provides an uplifting cerebral buzz followed by a mellow, body-soothing calm. Whether you're socializing, relaxing, or looking for a creative spark, Bubblegum keeps the vibes light, happy, and fresh.
